description: THE LAST ROCAF F-104 TO FLY; on 1998-05-08 at 09:00 4196 led the final two-ship transit from Hsinchu to Chingchuankang crewed by Lt Col 張玉山 in the front seat and Lt Col 田立杰 in the rear; mission number PC-90; the wingman was 4186 which is now at the Chiang Ching-kuo Memorial Hall in Kinmen
